creativity: Start with a template or make it your own.
showcase: A few ideas to get started
showcaseHint: Drag or swipe to explore the templates.
canvasHint: Combine images, text, video and 3D. Arrange your design with layers and masks.
effectsHint: Adjust colors, textures and effects. See each change on your design as you work.
motionHint: Start with a motion preset. Adjust the animation with keyframes and curves when you need more control.
agentHint: Use {{brandName}} commands and portable project files with your external agent to edit designs.
local: No account. Your projects stay with you.
timelapseHint: Turn your editing history into a timelapse. Your history stores 10,000 steps by default.
exportHint: Choose a resolution and check the preview in real time. Export images, timelapses or MP4/WebM video with audio.
